children: Germany’s retail sales fell 3.4% month-on-month in July 2026, following an upwardly revised flat reading in the previous month and missing market expectations for a 0.4% increase.
It marked the steepest decline since July 2021, with food sales dropping 0.8% and non-food sales falling 4.8%.
Online and mail-order sales also contracted 5.6%, pointing to weaker e-commerce demand.
On an annual basis, retail sales declined 2.5%, reversing an upwardly revised 0.6% increase in June and pointing to the fastest drop since September 2023.

title: German Retail Sales Slide 3.4%, Defy Forecasts
